set.body:
Scope:
Add persistent result reuse only for operations whose authors explicitly declare a sound memoization contract.

Acceptance criteria:
- Memoization is opt-in; default operations retain ordinary execution semantics.
- Cache identity includes the operation descriptor and schemas, canonical input digest, worker release or declared execution fingerprint, result contract, artifact declarations, and every explicitly declared environment factor that may affect semantics.
- Resource quantities are included only when the operation contract declares that they affect results; this policy is explicit rather than accidental.
- A cache hit returns digest-verified durable RemoteRef and complete ArtifactSet values through the normal successful TaskOutcome path.
- Unknown, Interrupted, Failed, PublicationFailed, incomplete, corrupt, schema-mismatched, or unverified records are never served.
- Concurrent identical submissions publish once or attach without partial visibility.
- Worker-release, operation-version, schema, artifact-contract, and relevant execution-fingerprint changes invalidate reuse.
- Corruption, concurrent writers, crash-before-publication, stale entries, local/batch/pool parity, and cache observability are adversarially tested.
set.title: SOJ.O3: Add explicit persistent memoization with verified publication
